'''Teleportation''' was a rare [[The Force/Legends|Force]] ability that enabled the user to move from one place to another almost instantaneously. [[Darth Jadus]] has shown his skills with this ability, as well as the entity [[Abeloth]].<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref> [[Darth Phobos]] may have also possessed this ability.<ref name="Star Wars:The Force Unleashed video game">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> Some of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Force Adept (Imperial)|Force Adepts]] who guarded his [[Imperial Archives (museum)/Legends|museum]] and vaults also possessed this power. [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] briefly alluded to this ability as he talked of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who could move themselves instantaneously through time and space. The [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] clan leader, [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] was proficient with this power. She appeared or disappeared in the form of green mist. [[Dread Masters|Dread Master]] [[Tyrans]] was able to use this Force ability himself between falling floor tiles instantaneously, when fighting a raid from both the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Dread Fortress|Dread Palace]]. [[:Raptus|Dread Master Raptus]] also showed talent in this ability teleporting others to the far side of his chambers, away from himself.<ref name="Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 6: The Prisoer of Bogan, Part 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 1]]</ref>

A similar power to instantly move persons, items, or even with the right technology, ships, was known as [[Fold space|Fold Space]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>

[[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] was an avid practitioner of this ability, capable of teleporting anywhere in his immediate vicinity.

It was among the most uncommon of rare Force powers, seeing rare use among [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who favored the power of the Force over lightsaber skills. It also consumed a bit more energy than some powers and took a bit more time to master. Most beings new to the skill could likely move no more than four feet away, while a master of this skill could likely move anywhere they could clearly see.
